title: Exclude PR4953 seven-call address-twist pattern at second order (no new κ)
body:
PR4953 leaves open the second-order test of its seven-call `J/P_s/D_s` pattern under arbitrary `S3 × S3` role twists. This package proves that the entire fixed pattern fails, in every call order. It closes that bounded handoff step; it does **not** prove a nine-call lower bound for arbitrary two-sided-twist words or claim a new κ.

The proof tests arbitrary dirty degree-one inputs modulo the cube of the augmentation ideal. Off-diagonal cancellation forces the shared/private relative transports to agree, so their diagonal first-order contributions cancel. Only the private diagonal rank-one call remains. The necessary condition is therefore `rank_F2(C_s mod 2) ≤ 1` for every target, excluding the three `I_3` targets. The statement also permits arbitrary odd-denominator rank-one frames and `PBQ` conjugations within this same three-role projector pattern.

For the exact predecessor assignment, input `[E00]+[0]` in role zero produces the nonzero role-one residual `t00² + t00·t11` in every order. This is new structural coverage beyond the predecessor's exact census of 5,040 orders for one twist assignment.

The change adds only `research/bit-address-twist-second-order/`: a written proof, a standalone exact verifier, scope/source/replay metadata, and validation notes. No predecessor, shared tool, or selected record changes.

Evidence at publication head `3ee15e813f921c547763e57c3e2578de403ab321`:

- Normal and optimized isolated Python 3.12.12 replay pass with identical JSON. Checks include all 11,664 reduced permutation-twist cancellation cases, all 511 nonzero linear forms, 36 permutation twists, two non-permutation `PBQ` fixtures, 110 comparisons with a separately implemented sparse finite-group oracle, and a 165-vector direct nine-call positive control.
- Three representative orders and the filtration identities corroborate the all-order proof. This is not another global order census. The verifier imports no predecessor code.
- Semantic call/frame/twist rejection controls pass. Five disposable verifier mutations each fail normally and with `-O`.
- Package metadata and registered normal/optimized replay pass. `check_research_commit.py --ref HEAD --check-source-history` passes for all seven committed files.
- Committed export integrity and fresh, read-only, Git-free normal/optimized replay pass, with the same JSON and unchanged extracted bytes. Export SHA-256: `0f70e5b1bc121457988c7774d35a9b5d45539c81cba20b2b3ea77fa748cdb454`.
- Hosted [CI run 39910640060](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39910640060) passed at this exact head: the plan job and the sole selected package replay both succeeded. This is execution evidence, not independent proof acceptance.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/bit-address-twist-second-order/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/bit-address-twist-second-order/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-address-twist-second-order
```

Direct replay takes about one second. The written proof is the quantified result; finite tests are corroboration. No independent human/Lean review, native twist pricing, full selected replay, or arbitrary seven/eight-call classification is claimed. Different projector patterns, additional mixing/helpers and even-denominator frames remain outside scope. The README states two concrete next questions.

Rebased for publication onto canonical main `f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1`; guidance, selected record and predecessor bytes are unchanged. The final overlap refresh at 06:14–06:16 UTC covers 300 open PRs, 4,310 closed PRs, 4,104 Discussion records and 6,712 local notes, with complete pagination; no overlapping second-order continuation appeared. This is advisory coverage, not a novelty guarantee.
